messages.content: Translate each English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Preserve meaning, names, scripture references, and unit order. Do not add explanations or content. Output JSON only: {"book_code":"JASHER","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"source_ref":"1:1","text_ar":"..."}]}. Return exactly one row for each input source_ref.

{"units":[{"source_ref":"5:24","text":"But the sons of men would not hearken, neither would they incline their ears to all their declarations.","chapter":5,"verse":24},{"source_ref":"5:25","text":"And it was after this that the Lord said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.","chapter":5,"verse":25},{"source_ref":"5:26","text":"And do thou take unto thee gopher wood, and go to a certain place and make a large ark, and place it in that spot.","chapter":5,"verse":26},{"source_ref":"5:27","text":"And thus shalt thou make it; three hundred cubits its length, fifty cubits broad and thirty cubits high.","chapter":5,"verse":27},{"source_ref":"5:28","text":"And thou shalt make unto thee a door, open at its side, and to a cubit thou shalt finish above, and cover it within and without with pitch.","chapter":5,"verse":28}],"book_code":"JASHER"}
